component.name: VideoItem
component.script: sub onContent() c = m.top.itemContent if c = invalid then return m.top.findNode("poster").uri = c.HDPosterUrl m.top.findNode("title").text = c.title m.top.findNode("meta").text = c.description d = c.ShortDescriptionLine2 m.top.findNode("dur").text = d m.top.findNode("badgeBg").visible = d <> "" end sub sub onFocus() f = m.top.focusPercent if not m.top.rowListHasFocus then f = 0 m.top.findNode("ring").opacity = f s = 1 + 0.04 * f m.top.findNode("card").scale = [s, s] if f > 0.5 then m.top.findNode("title").color = "0xFFFFFFFF" else m.top.findNode("title").color = "0xB8BBC0FF" end sub
